operationalValue: Decompose the run's largest oversized non-test Go file toward 500 lines.

definition.operationalValue: Decompose the run's largest oversized non-test Go file toward 500 lines.

evidence.opportunity: Largest non-test pkg/**/*.go blob at the run commit; below 1000 is healthy.
evidence.assignment: Greatest wc -l, reverse lexical tie-break. Key: go-file:<path> or repository-health:non-test-go-under-1000; duplicates repeat.
evidence.accepted: Git evidence of assigned-path reduction toward 500 lines or tree-proven absence; issues and traces are excluded.
evidence.collection: With contents:read, count newlines in the run commit archive for assignment and in the cutoff commit blob for evidence.
evidence.maturation: Two days; five pre-adoption issue/PR pairs (#1636-#3564) took 0.04-0.84 days.
evidence.zeroRule: No reduction from the initial oversized file scores 0.
evidence.missingRule: Invalid, unavailable, or truncated Git evidence scores null; tree-proven path absence is attainment.

primaryMetric.formula: initialLines < 1000 => 1; else clamp((initialLines-currentLines)/(initialLines-500),0,1). Proven absence sets currentLines=0.

diagnosticMetrics.name: Largest-file health at assignment
diagnosticMetrics.formula: min(1, 999 / initialLines) when the assignment archive contains eligible files.

diagnosticMetrics.name: Compliant line-mass share at assignment
diagnosticMetrics.formula: compliantLines / totalLines when the assignment archive contains eligible files and positive line mass.

metric.name: Largest-file health at assignment
metric.formula: min(1, 999 / initialLines) when the assignment archive contains eligible files.

metric.name: Compliant line-mass share at assignment
metric.formula: compliantLines / totalLines when the assignment archive contains eligible files and positive line mass.

caveat: Operational value is observational. Replayed historical values apply one frozen evaluator digest to every run and do not establish that the workflow caused the measured outcome.
